author: Huawei
description:
In moments of crisis, a live signal can be a lifeline.

Reliable communications help people reach loved ones, coordinate emergency response, and access support when it matters most.

Through #TECHcares, #Huawei is committed to working with partners and local teams to help safeguard vital communication lines across different countries and crisis situations, supporting communities through urgent response and recovery.

Because safeguarding communication lines means safeguarding lives. And behind every restored connection is the strength to recover, rebuild, and move forward together.

Learn More: https://bit.ly/4eNq3aM #BetterTogether #DigitalLifelines #WTISD@itutelecommunication
title: Connect to Protect
